final_state.description: Typed block identifier (includes state support such as `[facing=east]`) to be replaced when jigsaw activated.

name.description: Associated structure name, jigsaw identifier, such as `"template:bundle"`.

target.description: Required structure subset to be aligned with, such as, such as `"template:pipe"`.

target_pool.description: Pool in which jigsaws will be connected with each others, such as `"template:bundle/pipe"`.
